title: Text-variant augmentation pipeline
boundary_note: Safety framing = red-team augmentation of known (tame, prompt-injection style) attack prompts to stress-test a jailbreak monitor's robustness to rewording. Transforms are generic paraphrase/typo/obfuscation edits; no harmful content is produced.

rubric.desc: augment is reproducible from its seed (RNG seeded with `seed`)
a variant string is emitted at most once per run, across sources
a variant identical to its source is dropped
n_variants=0 returns [] (negative still raises ValueError)
AugmentBudget max_total is inclusive (no off-by-one allowing max+1)
AugmentBudget.remaining() implemented
synonym_swap replaces whole words only, not substrings
char_noise never turns a 1-character text into an empty string
leetspeak replaces uppercase letters as well as lowercase
insert_whitespace only widens inner gaps; leading/trailing whitespace untouched
compose() implemented (in-order, shared rng, joined name, identity for [])
shuffle_words implemented (seeded permutation, <2 words unchanged)
read_seeds skips blank lines and # comment lines
write_variants preserves non-ASCII text (ensure_ascii=False)
summarize() implemented
CLI accepts and honours --max-per-source
synonym_swap gives the replacement the matched word's capitalisation (Art -> Craft, ART -> CRAFT)
synonym_swap substitutes in one pass: a replacement is never itself swapped again by a later table key
char_noise always changes the text (a substitution never picks the same letter)
char_noise insertion can also go after the last character (off-by-one in the insert position)
shuffle_words never returns the original order when another order exists
compose copies its transform list; later mutation of the caller's list changes neither behaviour nor name
case_change's per-letter mode uses the supplied rng, not the global random module (planted slip)
AugmentBudget rejects negative caps with ValueError (0 allowed)
augment(transforms=[]) does not silently fall back to the default transforms (returns [] or raises ValueError)
augment rejects a bare string for seed_texts instead of treating each character as a source
record 'transform' name for a functools.partial is the wrapped function's name, not a repr with a memory address
read_seeds accepts a file starting with a UTF-8 byte-order mark
read_seeds raises ValueError naming the physical line number of malformed JSON
read_seeds raises ValueError naming the line for a record without a string 'text' field (missing key, non-string, non-object)
write_variants creates missing parent directories
write_variants is atomic: a serialisation failure leaves the previous file intact
CLI exits non-zero with a message naming the missing seeds file (no traceback, no output file)
CLI rejects negative -n / --max-total as a usage error (SystemExit non-zero), not a traceback or silent empty run
